selected_evidence.summary: After restart, /etc/logrotate.d/inventory-app persisted unchanged, logrotate.timer remained active/enabled, prior app.log/app.log.1.gz were intact, and a fresh append+forced-rotation+append cycle produced app.log.1.gz/app.log.2.gz with app.log immediately writable again

commands.command:
set -Eeuo pipefail
echo "== STEP 1: write logrotate config ==" 
sudo -n tee /etc/logrotate.d/inventory-app > /dev/null <<'EOF'
/var/log/inventory/app.log {
    daily
    rotate 7
    compress
    missingok
    notifempty
    copytruncate
}
EOF
cat /etc/logrotate.d/inventory-app

echo "== STEP 2: syntax/dry-run check =="
sudo -n logrotate -d /etc/logrotate.d/inventory-app 2>&1

echo "== STEP 3: seed some content and simulate a writer appending =="
echo "seed line $(date -Iseconds)" | sudo -n tee -a /var/log/inventory/app.log > /dev/null
( for i in 1 2 3 4 5; do echo "writer line $i $(date -Iseconds)" | sudo -n tee -a /var/log/inventory/app.log > /dev/null; sleep 1; done ) &
WRITER_PID=$!
sleep 2

echo "== STEP 4: force rotation while writer is active =="
sudo -n logrotate -f /etc/logrotate.d/inventory-app 2>&1

echo "== STEP 5: wait for writer to finish and inspect result =="
wait $WRITER_PID
sleep 1

echo "== rotated files =="
ls -la /var/log/inventory/

echo "== app.log content after rotation (should include post-rotation writer lines) =="
cat /var/log/inventory/app.log

echo "== rotated/compressed file content =="
zcat /var/log/inventory/app.log.1.gz 2>&1 || true
